description: Put an outcome that one document holds into another document of the same Space, and link the two. Use it to add a roadmap outcome to a NOICE ranking, a frame goal to the roadmap, and the like. Give toDocumentId for a document of the Space, or newToolKey to start a new document for the outcome. A target that already holds an outcome with that title is linked and not written. A tree holds one outcome, so a tree that has one refuses a second. For any other change to a document, use tools_apply_commands. Needs the owner or editor role.

column.description: The column, when the target is a roadmap. Later when absent.

documentId.description: The document that holds the outcome.

entityId.description: The outcome id inside that document, from spaces_list_outcomes.

newToolKey.description: Start a new document of this builder. Use it only without toDocumentId.

toDocumentId.description: The document to put the outcome in. It must be in the Space.

name: spaces_copy_outcome
title: Copy an outcome into another document of the Space
